contract: DESIGN.md common library and role-specific navigation, 2026-11-12. Teacher: library/tasks/students plus separate settings; student: library/tasks; member: library. Fresh shelf starts all, explicit browsing selection survives returns. Reading/editing has no common tabs.

accessibility.evidence: Shared navigation uses labelled nav, ordinary links and aria-current=page; teacher/student fixture scans at both viewports pass axe WCAG2 A/AA and2.1AA. Keyboard focus and reduced motion retain coverage. Admin screen does not mark tasks current.

responsive.evidence: Browser tests cover long class/task names, all teacher panels, library and student tasks at390px without document overflow. Ego screenshots show common tabs on desktop library and phone library/settings/students/tasks.

loading.evidence: Role and teacher URL panel hydrate before private dashboard contents. Existing delayed submission cancellation test remains green.

empty.evidence: Teacher empty class/student/task creation and empty shelf filters are exercised; new members can create a work from the shelf.

error.evidence: Task list retry retained. Main/ShortStory corrupted storage can navigate to tasks without altering raw original bytes. Direct-editor corrupt-storage download/restart test passes separately.

partial.evidence: Teacher assignment failure leaves class context and navigation available; retry remains explicit.

success.evidence: Teacher navigates tabs and renames class; regular member creates/writes and sees own work beside provided books; student starts task and returns to library.

permission.evidence: Role helper covers guest/member/teacher/admin/student. Student has no teacher management links; actual route gates remain. Existing student creation/image restrictions and account-switch coverage retained.

renderedEvidence.observation: Common teacher tabs attached to the wood library; all works filter selected.
All three teacher links and separate settings fit one phone row; library collection selector shows all works.
Student management is its own panel with student tab selected.
Code, class name and default permissions are grouped in separate settings.
Student has library and my tasks only; writing actions remain in assignment cards.

checks.focused_lint: 0 errors; two existing navigation warnings on the wider scope

test_harness_note: Initial concurrent browser commands shared Playwright artifact directories and failed during trace cleanup. Rerun used unique output directories; all final checks above passed.
limits: Local mocked accounts and toy manuscripts, no real student information.
No production deployment, actual authenticated sessions or physical-device verification.
Main personal shelf currently holds KnolStory own/imported/online works; authored ShortStory books remain in the linked picture-book library.
Fresh all-works default does not overwrite an explicitly chosen session filter/query/page.
